requirement.summary: TMS2.0 - Searching data trigger WAF interception, and the popped prompt message has no translation.
requirement.description:
Test Environment: HQ1

Scenario 1

-Test Step

- Go to TMS Operation >Search View, fill in "'!@#" in a search field.

- Click the [Search] button.

-Actual Result

A dialog pops up showing "access_denied_request_violates_security_policy", and the error message is not translated.

Scenario 2

-Test Step

- Go to TMS Operation >Current View > Walk In, right-click the page to open Developer Tools, then switch to the Network panel

- Fill in "'!@#" in the member info field, it will auto-search the member.

-Actual Result

An HTTP 403 error is observed in the browser network requests, but no pop-up message is displayed. This issue also exists on search fields of other pages, e.g., New Page, Member View.

requirement.summary: TMS 2.0 - Incorrect table used to mark arrival when table changed & WS disconnected
requirement.description:
Email/ ZOHO Title:

/

Use Case:

User claimed that they want to mark arrival to 61A, but it marked 60 to POS side

Steps to Reproduce:

Make a booking with table [1A]>change table via quick table change in reservation list [2A] > mark arrival

Current Result:

Used the old table [1A] to mark arrival [Unexpected]

Expected Result:

Use the most updated table [2A] to mark arrival [Expected]

Root Cause [Optional]:

when WS disconnected, this function always uses the record which stored in frontend.

I suggest creating an internal API that uses the reservation ID to retrieve the corresponding reservation tables and display them in the dialog. Please note that it is not advisable to have a loader shown before the dialog, as this can contribute to a slower experience for the operator.

requirement.summary: POS Export - BI Interface - Add pos_check_extra_infos data file (2/2)
requirement.description:
User Story

As an MGM compliance and audit stakeholder, I want the Infrasys BI interface to export a new pos_check_extra_infos data file so that we can meet external regulatory and audit reporting requirements.

Current Behavior

The Infrasys BI interface does not currently export a pos_check_extra_infos data file. The pos_check_extra_infos table exists in the database but its data is not included in any BI export. MGM receives the existing set of BI export files only, and there is no mechanism to extract pos_check_extra_infos data for external reporting purposes.

Expected Behavior

The Infrasys BI interface exports a new pos_check_extra_infos data file (e.g., real_pos_check_extra_infos_20260330090841.csv) as a brand-new file added to the existing set of BI export files. Existing files remain unchanged. The file is delivered via SFTP to the same server and directory path used by existing BI export files, on the same daily batch schedule.

The single CSV file contains data from three sections, each with its own filter logic:

ckei_section = 'pms' and ckei_by = 'payment' and coalesce(ckei_status,'') <> 'd'

ckei_section= discount

ckei_variable= member_number、reference

ckei_section=discount_reason

ckei_variable= id

Acceptance Criteria

Export pos_check_extra_infos data file on daily batch schedule

- Given the BI export job runs on its scheduled daily batch

- When the job generates the pos_check_extra_infos export

- Then a single CSV file is produced (e.g., real_pos_check_extra_infos_YYYYMMDDHHMMSS.csv) containing data from all three sections: pms/payment, discount, and discount_reason

- And the file is delivered via SFTP to the same server and directory path as the existing BI export files

- And all existing BI export files are generated and delivered unchanged

- But if no records match the filter criteria for a given batch, an empty file with headers only is still produced and delivered

Apply section-specific row-level filters to exported records

- Given records exist in the pos_check_extra_infos source table

- When the export file is generated

- Then for the pms/payment section, only records where ckei_section = 'pms' AND ckei_by = 'payment' AND ckei_status IS NOT NULL AND ckei_status <> '' AND ckei_status <> 'd' are included

- And for the discount section, only records where ckei_section = 'discount' AND ckei_status IS NOT NULL AND ckei_status <> '' AND ckei_status <> 'd' are included

- And for the discount_reason section, only records where ckei_section = 'discount_reason' AND ckei_status IS NOT NULL AND ckei_status <> '' AND ckei_status <> 'd' are included

- But records with ckei_status IS NULL, ckei_status = '' (empty string), or ckei_status = 'd' are excluded from all sections regardless of ckei_section or ckei_by values

File naming and format consistency

- Given the BI export job completes successfully

- When the pos_check_extra_infos file is written to the export destination

- Then the file name follows the pattern real_pos_check_extra_infos_YYYYMMDDHHMMSS.csv

- And the file uses the same CSV format, encoding, and delimiter conventions as the existing BI export files

- And the file includes a header row with column names matching the variable names from the source data

Supporting Evidence

Requested by KDI team for the MGM project. The export supports MGM's external reporting requirement for regulatory or audit purposes.

Example file name: real_pos_check_extra_infos_20260330090841.csv

Delivery: SFTP to same server and directory path as existing BI export files, on the same daily batch schedule.

Requested Timeline

Aligned with Priority: Medium

Preferred Quarter: Q2 2026

Notes: Delivery on same schedule as existing BI export files (daily batch). Regulatory/audit driver — if a firm regulatory deadline emerges, priority should be re-evaluated. No known dependencies on other tickets; the pos_check_extra_infos table already exists in the database.

Alternatives Considered

- Exporting each section (pms/payment, discount, discount_reason) as separate files — rejected in favor of a single combined file per requester confirmation.

- Applying the ckei_section = 'pms' AND ckei_by = 'payment' filter globally to all rows — rejected; the filter is section-specific. Discount and discount_reason sections use only the ckei_status filter (no ckei_section/ckei_by restriction beyond their own section identifiers).

- Modifying an existing BI export file to include this data — rejected; this is a brand-new file to avoid disrupting existing downstream consumers.

- Filtering columns on the pms/payment section — rejected; all columns from the pos_check_extra_infos table are exported for pms/payment records per requester confirmation.

Original Description (preserved by INF Prod. Studio)

request by KDI team for MGM project, Infrasys BI interface needs to support pos_check_extra_infos

Add a parameter to control the export file.

require data filter in 1 file:

example file name=real_pos_check_extra_infos_20260330090841.csv

ckei_section = 'pms' and ckei_by = 'payment' and coalesce(ckei_status,'') <> 'd'

ckei_section: discount

ckei_variable: member_number、reference

ckei_section: discount_reason

ckei_variable: id

requirement.summary: [Bugfix] MenuMediaObject is empty in data release if there is no menu_menus record for the config zone
requirement.description:
Current Behaviour

When publishing menu data for a config zone, if one parent of menu_media_objects (e.g. menu_menus) has no records to export while other parents (e.g. menu_items, menu_attributes) do, the later empty-parent export rewrites menu_media_objects.csv in write mode (header only). This truncates the CSV and removes media rows already exported from the other parents. The outlet then receives an empty menu_media_objects table after data release.

Expected Behaviour

menu_media_objects.csv should retain all media rows exported from parents that have data. An empty parent (no primary keys) should only ensure the CSV header exists if the file is missing, and must not wipe rows already written by other parents.

Bug Fixing:[Jira- 66733] [Bugfix] MenuMediaObject is empty in data release if there is no menu_menus record for the config zone
Description:
Fixed an issue where an export file could be cleared when it was written by multiple parent data sources and a later parent had no data to export.
The issue caused data already written to the export file to be cleared when a subsequent empty export processed the same file in header-only mode.
After this fix, an empty export no longer clears existing data in the export file.
Setup:
When publishing menu data for a config zone, a table has multiple parent data sources (e.g. menu_media_objects).
One parent data source (e.g. menu_menus) has no records to export, while other parent data sources (e.g. menu_items and menu_attributes) have records to export
After the fix, verify that the data exported by the previous parent is retained when the subsequent parent has no data to export.
